name: Detergent Powder
description: Washing powder for laundry, used for both bucket hand-washing and washing machines. A 1 kg pack covers a small family's clothes for roughly two to three weeks.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/40101707/surf-excel-easy-wash-detergent-powder-1-kg/ (listed Rs 128, Sept 2026); economy alternatives Wheel Active / Nirma 1 kg are about Rs 70-80
notes: Image shows a Ghadi 1 kg pack (Hindi label), the only clean 1 kg Indian detergent pack on Commons; generic Commons detergent photos were close-ups of granules. Brand suggestion is Karnataka-typical, not the pictured brand.

name: Detergent Bar
description: A hard laundry soap bar for washing clothes by hand, rubbed straight onto collars, cuffs and stains before a bucket wash. A 250 g bar lasts a small household a week or two of daily washing.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/40002072/rin-detergent-bar-250-g/ (listed Rs 20, Sept 2026); Wheel and Surf Excel 250 g bars sit in the Rs 15-30 band
notes: Photo is a plain Sunlight laundry bar (museum object photo on Commons), generic look; no Rin/Wheel pack shot exists on Commons or Openverse. Brand suggestion is Karnataka-typical, not the pictured bar.

name: Dishwash Liquid
description: Concentrated liquid for washing vessels by hand; a few drops on a wet scrubber cleans oily tawas and steel plates. A 500 ml bottle covers a small family's daily dishes for about a month.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/266962/vim-dishwash-liquid-gel-lemon-500-ml-bottle/ (listed Rs 125, Sept 2026); Blinkit shows MRP Rs 140
notes: Photo is an unbranded Indian dishwash gel bottle (Quityfress label) from Commons; the pictured brand is not the suggested one.

name: Toilet Cleaner
description: Thick acidic liquid squeezed under the rim of the toilet bowl to remove stains and limescale, left for a few minutes and brushed off. A 500 ml bottle lasts a household about a month of regular cleaning.
mrp_source: https://www.zeptonow.com/pn/harpic-toilet-cleaner-liquid-original/pvid/63bc43f6-2538-42a6-9d43-748300c1c5f0 (MRP Rs 110, Sept 2026)
notes: In-use photo of a generic toilet-cleaner bottle from Commons; landscape framing.

name: Bathing Soap
description: A bar of bathing soap for daily use. The 100 g bar is the standard family size on every kirana shelf and lasts one person roughly two to three weeks.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/263856/santoor-sandal-turmeric-soap-super-saver-pack-100-g/ (single 100 g bar listed Rs 39, Sept 2026); pack MRP about Rs 40-45
notes: Photo shows a Mysore Sandal Centennial 100 g carton (KSDL, Bengaluru) from Commons: a Karnataka brand, though Santoor and Lifebuoy 100 g move more volume in kiranas.

name: Shampoo Bottle
description: Everyday hair-wash shampoo in a bottle rather than sachets, for families who wash hair several times a week. A 180 ml bottle gives roughly 20 to 25 washes.
mrp_source: Clinic Plus Strong & Long 175 ml (nearest pack): https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/266631/clinic-plus-strong-long-health-shampoo-175-ml/ Rs 115; BazaarBandhu lists MRP Rs 118; 1mg MRP Rs 133
notes: Photo is a Dove 80 ml bottle (CC0, Commons), used for the generic bottle look; Clinic Plus comes as 175 ml, the nearest pack to 180 ml.

name: Toothpaste
description: Fluoride toothpaste in a squeeze tube for twice-daily brushing. A 100 g tube lasts one adult about a month, or a couple two to three weeks.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/100006161/colgate-strong-teeth-anticavity-toothpaste-with-amino-shakti-formula-provides-fresher-breath-100-g/ (listed Rs 76, Sept 2026); price-history MRP Rs 73
notes: Photo is a Colgate 100 ml tube (UK variant) on a black background, from Commons.

name: Toothbrush
description: A manual toothbrush with soft or medium nylon bristles, sold singly. It should be replaced every three months or when the bristles splay.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026: Colgate ZigZag singles sell at Rs 25-40 (https://www.mkretail.com/product/colgate-tooth-brush-zig-zag-charcoal-soft lists the Charcoal variant at Rs 40)
notes: Photo shows three generic toothbrushes (public domain, Commons).

name: Hair Oil
description: Pure coconut oil for daily hair oiling, the usual choice in Karnataka homes, and for weekend oil baths. A 100 ml bottle lasts one person around a month.
mrp_source: https://budgetbazaar.online/product/parachute-coconut-oil-100ml-jaar/ (MRP Rs 71, sells Rs 65, Sept 2026)
notes: Photo shows the Rs 10 / 25 ml Parachute bottle from Commons, not the 100 ml pack.

name: Talcum Powder
description: Perfumed talc dusted on after a bath to keep the skin dry in Hospet's heat. A 100 g bottle lasts a person about a month in summer.
mrp_source: https://budgetbazaar.online/product/ponds-dream-flower-powder-100g/ (MRP Rs 125, Sept 2026); bigbasket sells the 100 g at Rs 100
notes: Photo is a vintage Johnson's Baby Powder talc tin (CC0, Commons), the only clean talc-container shot found; not a current Indian pack.

name: Sanitary Pads
description: Disposable sanitary napkins with wings, in a pouch of 8 pads. One pouch usually covers a single period.
mrp_source: estimate, Sept 2026: Whisper Choice Wings 8-pad pouch and Stayfree Secure XL 6 pads (https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/303412/stayfree-sanitary-pads-secure-xl-cottony-soft-with-wings-6-pads/ Rs 45) sell in the Rs 40-50 band
notes: Photo shows a single unbranded pad on white (Commons), not a pack.

name: Shaving Cream
description: Lather shaving cream in a tube, worked up with a brush or fingers before a razor shave. A 70 g tube gives a month or two of regular shaves.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/20004808/gillette-regular-pre-shave-cream-70-g/ (listed Rs 71.25); Budget Bazaar MRP Rs 75, Sept 2026
notes: Photo is an Indian Crolon lather shaving cream tube from Commons; the pictured brand is not the suggested one.

name: Agarbatti
description: Incense sticks, called oodubatti in Kannada, lit at the pooja corner morning and evening. A standard pack of 20 to 40 sticks lasts two to three weeks of daily use.
mrp_source: https://vaidhikamart.com/product/cycle-3-in-1-agarbatti-mrp-25 (regular pack MRP Rs 25, Sept 2026); larger Rs 75 and Rs 150 packs also sold
notes: Photo shows loose agarbatti sticks in a shop tray in Kochi (Commons), not a branded pack. Cycle is made in Mysuru.

name: Matchbox
description: A box of safety matches, benkipottana in Kannada, for lighting the gas stove, agarbatti and lamps. One box holds about 40 to 50 sticks.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026: the standard matchbox moved from Rs 1 to Rs 2 in December 2021 and has stayed there
notes: Photo shows a Tiger-brand Indian matchbox (CC0, Commons).

name: Candle
description: Plain white wax candles for power cuts and pooja, sold as a packet of about six to ten. Each candle burns for two to three hours.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026: Kochi maker Popular Candles wholesales 6-pc household packs at about Rs 12-14 (https://www.popularcandles.in/household-candles.html); retail packets sell for Rs 20-30
notes: Photo is a packet of plain white candles on a table (CC0, Commons); some clutter in frame. Candles are local/unbranded in kiranas.

name: Garbage Bags
description: Black plastic dustbin liners, medium size (19 x 21 inch), on a roll of 30. One roll covers a household for about a month of daily bin changes.
mrp_source: typical shelf price, Sept 2026: Amazon.in lists Clean India and Presto medium 30-pc rolls at roughly Rs 60-100 per roll (https://www.amazon.in/Clean-India%C2%AE-Garbage-Bags-Medium/dp/B0892QBDZJ)
notes: Photo shows a roll of black bin bags (public domain, Commons).

name: Aluminium Foil
description: Kitchen aluminium foil on a roll for wrapping chapatis and packing tiffin. The 9 m roll is the usual household size and lasts a family a month or two.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/100014975/hindalco-freshwrapp-standard-aluminium-foil-9-mtr-carton/ (listed Rs 130, Sept 2026)
notes: Photo shows a sheet of foil held up (Commons), not a boxed roll.

name: Dishwash Bar
description: A hard bar for scrubbing vessels by hand: rub a wet scrubber on the bar, clean the pots and rinse. A 300 g bar lasts a small family two to three weeks of daily dish washing.
mrp_source: https://www.apollopharmacy.in/otc/vim-dishwash-bar-300g (listed Rs 30, Sept 2026); bigbasket/Flipkart show Rs 25-30 for the 300 g bar
notes: Generic stand-in: a plain bar of carbolic soap (Commons). No Vim/Exo dishwash bar photo exists on Commons or Openverse (searched Vim bar, dishwashing bar, dish soap bar, scouring bar); store should replace with its own pack shot.

name: Floor Cleaner
description: Disinfectant floor cleaner diluted in a bucket of water for daily mopping of tiles and mosaic floors. A 1 L bottle gives roughly a month of once-a-day mopping in a two-room house.
mrp_source: https://blinkit.com/prn/lizol-disinfectant-surface-floor-cleaner-1-l/prid/18577 (MRP Rs 260, sells Rs 224, Sept 2026)
notes: Generic stand-in: a Lysol all-purpose cleaner spray bottle (Lysol is Lizol's name outside India). No Lizol pour-bottle photo on Commons or Openverse; landscape framing.

name: Phenyl
description: White phenyl, a strong-smelling disinfectant fluid mixed into mopping water for floors, bathrooms and drains. A 1 L bottle lasts a household one to two months.
mrp_source: https://www.bigbasket.com/pd/40057395/sunrise-white-phenyl-extra-strong-1-l/ (listed Rs 85, Sept 2026); unbranded 1 L white phenyl sells for Rs 40-70
notes: No image: Wikimedia Commons (phenyl, phenyle, white phenyl, Bengal Chemicals, Hindi spelling, disinfectant liquid bottle, floor disinfectant) and Openverse (phenyle, pine disinfectant bottle, disinfectant floor cleaner) return only chemistry diagrams, Lysol adverts or unrelated scenes. Store should photograph its own bottle. Brands vary by distributor; Sunrise/Trishul/Bengal are the usual labels.

name: Shampoo Sachet
description: A single-wash sachet of shampoo, the way most households in Hospet buy shampoo. One sachet is enough for one wash of shoulder-length hair.
mrp_source: https://www.humarabazar.com/product-page/clinic-plus-rs-1 (Clinic Plus Strong & Long Rs 1 sachet, 5.5-6.5 ml, Sept 2026); Rs 2 sachets (about 8 ml) and Chik Rs 1 sachets are the other kirana staples
notes: Generic stand-in: vintage Lux shampoo sachets (Museum Rotterdam photo on Commons). No current Indian sachet photo on Commons or Openverse (searched shampoo sachet, sachets India shop, shampoo pouch, Clinic Plus, Chik).
